raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 delivered `txn_ts` as epoch-millisecond strings (e.g. '1768629721000' = 2026-01-17 06:02:01 UTC) instead of the ISO format used elsewhere. The plain `CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)` fails on these rows; the values are consistent with the surrounding 06:00-06:07 transaction window, so they can be parsed as UTC epoch milliseconds. The fix rewrites only silver_transactions to convert 13-digit values with epoch_ms and keep the ISO path otherwise.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]{13}') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]{13}') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
